title: Unique Aerated Greek Banana Loukoumades
description: A rich and aerated Greek dessert featuring banana, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, gluten-free friendly and formed into loukoumades.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine mashed bananas, almond flour, granulated sugar, eggs, baking powder, and salt, and mix until well combined.
Add melted unsalted butter, lemon zest, and fresh lemon juice to the mixture and stir until smooth.
Cut banana leaves into large squares and brush with water.
Place a tablespoon of the banana mixture onto the center of each banana leaf square.
Fold the banana leaf over the mixture to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the wrapped loukoumades in a steamer basket, leaving space between each one.
Steam the loukoumades over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and fluffy.
Serve the Unique Aerated Greek Banana Loukoumades warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
